test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'illicite'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word 'illicite' is 'illicit'.
 
• The word 'illicit' means forbidden by law, rules, or custom.
 
 
• Example: He was arrested for selling illicit copies of the software.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the incorrectly spelt word is 'Illicite'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Illegal- Contrary to or forbidden by law, especially criminal law.
 
• Impunity- Exemption from punishment or freedom from the injurious consequences of an action.
 
• Illegible- Not clear enough to be read.
